calls.statement:
WITH n AS (
SELECT s.store_id, d.fiscal_year, f.net_amount AS v
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
UNION ALL
SELECT s.store_id, d.fiscal_year, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27'))
SELECT n.store_id, c.store_name, c.sqm, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN v END)) ly, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN v END)) ytd
FROM n JOIN dim_store c ON c.store_id=n.store_id AND c.is_current GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY ly DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 15

SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sqm DESC) AS rank, store_id, store_name, sqm
FROM dim_store
WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900 AND close_date IS NULL
QUALIFY RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sqm DESC) <= 10
ORDER BY sqm DESC
